recognize_zh: 低倍下多片大腸黏膜切片的固有層被瀰漫性、密集的淋巴浸潤撐開，腺窩被推開但仍保留，部分片段幾乎整片被淋巴細胞取代，未見潰瘍或大面積壞死。
features: Multiple mucosal biopsy fragments at scanning magnification
Diffuse, dense expansion of the lamina propria by a basophilic cellular infiltrate
Crypts spread apart but retained, without marked architectural destruction
Some fragments almost completely replaced by the infiltrate
No ulceration, necrosis or nodular follicular pattern evident at this power
describe_en: Low-power H&E sections of multiple colonic mucosal biopsy fragments show diffuse expansion of the lamina propria by a dense cellular infiltrate that separates but does not destroy the crypts; some fragments are almost entirely composed of the infiltrate. No ulceration, necrosis or follicular architecture is evident at this magnification. Higher-power cytology and immunophenotyping are needed; in this case the pattern is consistent with mucosal involvement by indolent T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder of the gastrointestinal tract.

ddx.vs: MALT lymphoma often shows reactive follicles with colonized germinal centers and lymphoepithelial lesions, and is CD20-positive.

ddx.dx: Mantle cell or follicular lymphoma of the GI tract
ddx.vs: These B-cell lymphomas tend to form nodular or follicular patterns and express CD20 with cyclin D1 or CD10/BCL2.
IBD shows crypt distortion, basal plasmacytosis and cryptitis with a polymorphous infiltrate.
